meta.title: Mode switch
meta.description: Adds the composer's missing Plan button. While plan mode is off, a neutral Plan control appears next to the permissions pill; clicking it enters plan mode, where the agent explores and proposes a plan before changing files. The built-in Plan chip then takes over as the way back to execution, so the two controls never appear together. The button uses the built-in plan state and /plan command, so the logged mode survives reloads, resume, and forks. Plan mode is guidance, not an enforced read-only sandbox.
